part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `TokensAnalyzer` (src/Tokenizer/TokensAnalyzer.php): when determining whether `&` after a type is a by-reference marker (unary predecessor) vs a binary operator, all function-declaration detection only looked for `T_FUNCTION`. For arrow functions the keyword is `T_FN`, so `&` in `fn (string &$x)` was misclassified as a binary operator, and `binary_operator_spaces` then inserted a space inside the parameter list.

The fix extends every detection point in `isUnaryPredecessorOperator` (and the analogous `FOO & $bar` check in `isConstantInvocation`) to also accept `T_FN`.

Validation:
- Repro from the issue no longer produces any diff under `binary_operator_spaces`.
- Real binary `&` cases (`A&B`, `5&3`) still get spaced.
- `tests/Tokenizer/TokensAnalyzerTest`, `BinaryOperatorSpacesFixerTest`, `ReferenceAnalyzerTest`: 349 tests OK; full `tests/Tokenizer` tree: 1891 tests OK.
- Full suite: only 4 pre-existing environment-related smoke/cache failures, confirmed identical on a clean checkout.
